recognize_zh: 骨髓切片上方的骨膜旁軟組織內，數條小血管壁被無細胞、淡粉紅、均質蠟樣物質環狀增厚，管腔狹小，周圍間質也呈淡染無定形沉積；這種血管壁為主的均質沉積提示類澱粉沉積症（amyloidosis）。
features: Multiple small vessels in periosteal/soft tissue with concentrically thickened walls
Wall deposits are acellular, homogeneous, pale eosinophilic, and waxy with narrowed lumens
Similar pale amorphous material in the adjacent interstitial stroma
Intervening bony trabecula with a small marrow space
Underlying marrow of moderate cellularity with fat; no plasma cell sheets identifiable at this power
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E) at low power shows a bony trabecula separating underlying moderately cellular marrow from overlying periosteal soft tissue. Several small vessels in the soft tissue have concentrically thickened walls replaced by acellular, homogeneous, waxy pale eosinophilic material with luminal narrowing, and similar amorphous material infiltrates the adjacent stroma. Plasma cell infiltration cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are suggestive of amyloid deposition; confirmation by Congo red staining with apple-green birefringence, amyloid typing, and evaluation for a clonal plasma cell neoplasm are recommended.

ddx.vs: Homogeneous hyaline vessel walls are Congo red negative and lack apple-green birefringence under polarized light.
Collagen is more fibrillar with scattered fibroblast nuclei and is Congo red negative and trichrome positive.
Deposits are Congo red negative and non-fibrillary on electron microscopy, often with a kappa light chain.
Consists of pale Alcian blue-positive interstitial material replacing marrow fat rather than vessel wall deposits.
